run_train_loop: run the train_loop function to start policy gradient training with a Hydra config
run_preprocess: run the preprocess function to validate and save job configuration data
run_NPG_agent: run the NPG algorithm by constructing an NPG agent with policy and baseline
run_PPO_agent: run the PPO algorithm by constructing a PPO agent with policy and baseline
run_train_agent: run the train_agent function to train an RL agent with specified hyperparameters
